scope: 48 bilingual explanatory units under exactly 39 canonical Mass section owners, plus 16 paragraphs in eight existing thematic lessons. Original 20 polished, 24 additional, four new supplemental. The number 48 here is NOT an implementation of historic 48-card LIVE design.

firstPassExternalCorroboration.verifiedAspect: Novis hisce temporibus 13 November 1962; effective 8 December 1962; St Joseph inserted into ordinary and special Communicantes wording.
At Requiem Agnus Dei dona eis requiem with no breast strikes; the first peace prayer and kiss of peace omitted; Requiescant in pace and no final blessing.
Secondary historical study reports pre-1962 second Confiteor no longer prescribed in the 1962 rubric; usage disputes and local custom should not be presented as a universal rule.
